description: Export the 'customers' table from the Chinook database to a CSV file. The export MUST be saved to exactly: /home/ga/Documents/exports/customers_export.csv (this exact path and filename is required). The CSV must contain all 59 customer records with a header row including columns: CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Company, Address, City, State, Country, PostalCode, Phone, Fax, Email, SupportRepId. Connect to chinook.db, navigate to the customers table, and use DBeaver's export feature.
